svg.text: A road becomes a family of time-indexed movements.
Hong Kong • recorded HK10 excerpt • t24–30, 30 s per step; not the full horizon
A/B: entry/exit states; pale arcs: adjacent parts of the same HK10 path.
movement arc advances to its saved arrival time
turn connector links road states at the same time
waiting arc advances one step at the same state
Original roads: 10468 → 10513 → 10526. Turns are not roads.
308368 at t26–27; zero-time turn; 667532 at t27–28
The restricted master enforces shared arc capacities.
HK10 has no waiting arc in its complete saved column.
No separate cross-OD exchange is claimed for this excerpt.
Minimize cost; compare to the same arc-flow LP
Schematic coordinates; exact routing states, arc IDs and times come from the approved HK10 excerpt. No observed GPS trajectory is shown.
Full path arrival: t37; sink at t50 is bookkeeping, not physical waiting. The full horizon and terminal connections are omitted.
